audit.why: Qiyana-favoured (53.04% WR, 526 games): Annie takes level 1 with point-and-click Q and a spawned Pyromania, Qiyana owns the lane from 2 on; Annie's threat is the Flash-Tibbers teamfight, matching the page framing.

Spikes: level 2-3 (element online, out-burst her stun-down window), level 6 (burst her before Tibbers when passive is grey), first item (stealth one-combo), late (she stays a pick target with zero mobility). All four spikes[] present and kit-grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: 17 misgendered fields (Annie called he/his); dosFull[1].t claimed a 'post-combo silence' Annie does not have; the shield-absorbs-burst interaction (Molten Shield, 10s CD) was missing from the page; cooldowns field had no digit; full chart rows 4/6 said Annie against content win Qiyana and rows 0-3/5 carried blanket Skill against packet+content Annie/Qiyana x6.
audit.why: Annie's kit: Pyromania stuns on the 4th spell and she spawns with it; Q 4s point-and-click projectile; Molten Shield E 10s absorbs your burst; Tibbers R 130/115/100s hard CC zone. No silence anywhere in her kit.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, silence claim replaced with a Pyromania-count trigger, Molten Shield interaction written into dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers, chart sides aligned to Annie/Qiyana x6 with rewritten whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes.
audit.corrected: New bodies: stack-counting commit rule and the Molten Shield burst-absorb warning.
